def: An EU AI Act assessment that public bodies, public-service providers and deployers of credit-scoring or life and health insurance pricing AI must complete before first using an Annex III high-risk system.
practice: It covers affected groups, specific risks, human oversight and remedies, goes to the market surveillance authority, can reuse a GDPR data protection impact assessment, and applies from 2 December 2027 (as of November 2026).
